extraFacts.fact: ASME B1.20.1 is the standard for general-purpose inch pipe threads: NPT tapered threads, and NPSM straight mechanical pipe threads, with a 60° thread angle.

extraFacts.fact: SAE J1926 / ISO 11926 is the O-ring boss straight-thread port: a UN/UNF thread with an O-ring under the shoulder that makes the seal.

extraFacts.fact: SAE J514 pipe-thread ratings by size: 1/8 NPT 5,000 psi; 1/4 NPT 5,000 psi; 3/8 NPT 4,000 psi; 1/2 NPT 3,000 psi; 3/4 NPT 3,000 psi; 1 NPT 2,000 psi; 1-1/4 NPT 1,150 psi; 1-1/2 NPT 1,000 psi; 2 NPT 1,000 psi, so NPT ends cap a hose assembly in the larger sizes.

extraFacts.fact: The male 37° flare (JIC) and the SAE 45° flare have different cone angles and do not seal against each other.

faqs.q: What is the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting used for?
faqs.a: The 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting is a 45° elbow hose fitting with a female swivel nut that seats on the SAE 45° flare cone, in UN/UNF threads from 7/16-20 to 1-1/16-14. It turns a hose through a moderate angle at the port on refrigerant lines and lower-pressure hydraulic circuits that take a 45° flare.

faqs.q: What should I send to order the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting?
faqs.a: Send the hose grade and bore, the SAE 45° flare size you need and the overall length, and Indus will quote the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting with the matching crimp ferrule. State the dash size and that you need the 45° elbow style. Crimping is quoted separately, and a full assembly with pressure testing and certification is available on request.

faqs.q: What sizes does the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting come in?
faqs.a: The 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting covers the nominal size range -04 to -12, in UN/UNF (7/16-20 to 1-1/16-14). Choose the thread by the flare port it screws onto, from 7/16-20 at the small end up to 1-1/16-14. Common sizes are ex-stock and less common thread and bore combinations typically ship within 7 working days.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no rating for the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting on its own: the assembly takes the rating of the hose grade and crimp ferrule it is crimped to, and Indus confirms the working pressure when it quotes the assembly. For an elbow the bend is set by the fitting, so the hose needs less routing clearance than a straight fitting. Operating temperature is -40°C to +120°C, and the fluid compatibility chart applies to aggressive media.

faqs.a: The 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting is made from carbon steel with stainless steel on request, finished zinc-plated, Cr3+ passivated, RoHS-compliant.

faqs.q: Which standard does the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting follow?
faqs.a: The 45° Cone Seat is covered by SAE J512, and the listing names that standard. Quote the standard together with the thread size on your RFQ, so the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting is matched to the port it screws into.

faqs.q: What does the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting connect to?
faqs.a: It screws onto a male SAE 45° flare port or tube end on refrigerant and lower-pressure hydraulic equipment. For a 37° flare port you need a different fitting from the [JIC 37° hose fittings](/c/jic-37-hose-fittings) range, because the two cone angles do not seal against each other.

faqs.q: How do I fit the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting so it seals?
faqs.a: To fit the 45° SAE Female 45° Cone Hose Fitting, seat the swivel nut on the cone and tighten it until the cone seals; the seal is the metal cone, not the thread. Do not substitute a fitting with a different sealing form, since mismatched sealing forms can leak under pressure. See the [make-up torque guide](/blog/hydraulic-fitting-make-up-torque) for how far to turn.
